summary: Executed 17 pytest cases + full UI sweep (Home, Docs, Explore, Live, Dashboard, /mm, /launch, /launch?wallethelp=1, /desk/{id}). 15/17 backend tests pass. Launch wizard renders all 6 steps, uploads image locally, reaches Review, surfaces WalletHelpPanel + Mint-without-a-maker fallback with required data-testids. /mm live eligibility check against DGK15...XTAt resolves live price/balance via /api/relay/coins/{mint}/check. /desk page renders chart, stats, wallets, maker controls with neutral external labels (Market/Chart/Explorer). No branding leaks (makers.fun/$MAKERS/pump.fun/Solscan/DexScreener) anywhere in UI. Found 2 real bugs: (1) native-launch media/metadata URLs are built from request.base_url which returns the internal k8s cluster hostname (http://maker-hub-325.cluster-17.preview.emergentcf.cloud/...) — those URLs return 403 externally, so PumpPortal and any wallet cannot fetch the image or metadata JSON, breaking the native-launch fallback end-to-end. (2) TypeBadge shows 'LAUNCHED HERE' for any desk whose upstream origin==='launch', including upstream-global desks never recorded in our_desks — a scoping-leak that mislabels foreign coins as being launched on this site.

critical.issue: Returned url/uri uses request.base_url which resolves to the internal k8s hostname (http://maker-hub-325.cluster-17.preview.emergentcf.cloud/api/media/<id>) instead of REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. External GET to that URL returns 403, so PumpPortal cannot fetch image/metadata and the native-launch fallback cannot complete. Fix: use a PUBLIC_BASE_URL env var or trust X-Forwarded-Host/Proto headers to build absolute URLs.

ui_bugs.issue: Shows 'LAUNCHED HERE' for every desk with origin==='launch' from the relay, including upstream-global desks that are NOT in /api/our/desks. On /desk/9ccd0c18-... the badge rendered even though our_desks is []. Should check against ourDesks (useOurDesks.js) or an isOurs flag before labeling.

action_items: Backend: build media/metadata absolute URLs from a configurable PUBLIC_BASE_URL (fallback to X-Forwarded-Proto + X-Forwarded-Host) instead of request.base_url, so PumpPortal and wallets can actually fetch the artwork + metadata during the native-launch fallback.
Frontend: gate TypeBadge 'LAUNCHED HERE'/'ONBOARDED' labels on the desk being present in useOurDesks(); otherwise render no badge (or 'UPSTREAM').
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses request.base_url for user-visible absolute URLs — unsafe behind an ingress; always derive public URL from env or X-Forwarded-* headers.

server.py: on launches/{id}/submit the proxy records the desk id but does not persist the on-chain mint/name/image, so /api/our/desks cannot be joined to relay-desk metadata for scoping on Explore/Live without a second round trip — consider storing minimal denormalized info at submit time.
Launch.jsx: Image is only uploaded at submit time via a toast ('Image kept locally'); if submit fails after upload the toast flow does not surface the uploadId for retry.
TypeBadge collapses two very different states (upstream origin vs recorded-here) into the same label — core data-scoping requirement from the problem statement.
test_credentials: Solana wallet SIWS only — no email/password. Headless UI test verifies connect/sign-in prompts render correctly.
seed_data_creation: None (uploads/image created a transient media doc that remains in db.media; harmless).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and run with pytest (configfile already in /app/backend/pytest.ini). Live upstream desk id for /desk testing can be fetched with GET /api/relay/desks?limit=1 — currently 9ccd0c18-27b4-41c4-bce9-3d2f41e89b6d (mint DGK15bQv2s4N1bcyvLCRembP43ZbnzL2H6Mskq5bXTAt). To reach /launch review step headlessly fill name+ticker+PNG via the file input then click launch-next-btn 5 times. Wallethelp fallback is triggered by ?wallethelp=1 query param. our_desks and our_launches are currently empty by design.
rca of the issue: Native-launch media/metadata 403: FastAPI's request.base_url is composed from the ASGI scope 'server' + 'scheme', which is the pod-internal host when behind the ingress. The kubernetes ingress only serves 443/https on the public preview domain, so the returned http://*.cluster-17.*.cloud/api/media/<id> is unreachable (ingress returns 403). Repro: curl -X POST --data-binary @img.png https://maker-hub-325.preview.emergentagent.com/api/uploads/image → url field hostname is the internal cluster. GET that URL from outside → HTTP 403. Mitigation: add PUBLIC_BASE_URL to backend/.env (e.g. the same preview URL that frontend uses) and construct URLs as f"{PUBLIC_BASE_URL}/api/media/{mid}"; or honor request.headers.get('x-forwarded-proto')+'://'+request.headers.get('x-forwarded-host'). TypeBadge scoping leak: in components/bits.jsx line 124 the badge is derived purely from desk.origin returned by the upstream relay; it must be cross-checked against useOurDesks (ourDesks.some(d => d.deskId === desk.id)) before labeling as LAUNCHED HERE or ONBOARDED.
